emma: Follow-up thread for the vendor/dependency outage PM. Owners please ack + ETA.

raj: Ack. Can we list discrete actions to attach to INC-2026-419?

emma: Yes 1 items: emergency fallback blobstore; cached model manifests; model-registry auth graceful-degrade; provider escalation + backup contacts; monthly recurrence dashboard; post-deploy smoke tests.

hao: I'll take cached manifests. Plan: persist last-known manifest in redis with 10m TTL, serve cached metadata for up to 90s on registry failures. ETA branch by 2026-03-31.

emma: @hao add an acceptance test simulating registry timeouts.

raj: I will own the monthly recurrence dashboard and telemetry panel. ETA 2026-04-01.

taylor: I'll build the emergency fallback blobstore: cross-cloud read-only backup sync every 12h + manual failover steps. ETA 2026-04-08. Will include reconciliation script.

ops-bot: Created INC-2026-419 and linked jira: https://jira.internal/browse/INC-2026-419

vendor-eng: Adding a 24/7 manager contact for provider-A and requesting faster engagement SLA. Update by 2026-03-23 COB.

product-ops: Legal asked for sample "availability credits" clause. I'll draft and share by next week.

hao: Also implementing single-flight token refresh in client to avoid stampedes. ETA 2026-03-28.

taylor: For post-deploy smoke: job runs 5 registry+auth queries, blocks rollout on failures or >450ms. ETA 2026-04-05.

raj: Telemetry fields for failover events: event_type, triggered_by, duration_ms, affected_route, fallback_action, owner_team.

product-ops: Draft contract clause uploaded: https://confluence.internal/display/OPS/Vendor+Credits+Draft (WIP).

hao: Draft PR pushed: https://git.internal/p/cached-manifest-wip

raj: Grafana panel in staging: https://grafana.internal/d/incident-patterns

emma: Recap owners/ETAs: hao 2026-03-28/2026-03-31; taylor 2026-04-08/2026-04-05; raj 2026-04-01; product-ops 2026-03-30; vendor-eng 2026-03-23.

ops-bot: Recurring incident-pattern review scheduled 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC.

emma: Thanks. Drop PR/ticket links in INC-2026-419 and react with :white_check_mark: when done.

vendor-eng: Contact card added to INC-2026-419 and pinged provider-A.

emma: Closing thread, will review at the weekly on-call sync.
